# System

**Package** `telividb.system.v1`

## Services

### `SystemInfo`

Reports what only this process can know about itself.  Telemetry here emits shape, never values — `dimensions=768`, never the components. A vector in a log is readable by anyone with log access and can be inverted back toward its source text.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GetSystem` | `GetSystemRequest` | `System` | Retrieves the selected backend, the device, and the memory budget. |

## Messages

### `System`

Runtime facts an orchestrator cannot observe from outside the process.  Deliberately small. Liveness, restarts, CPU and memory limits and GPU allocation are all things a scheduler already does better than a database can. What remains is what only this process knows — and the most important of it is which backend was actually selected, because a build that quietly fell back to the CPU passes every correctness test while delivering none of the speed. From outside, that failure is invisible: the pod is healthy, the GPU is allocated, and nothing is using it.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the singleton. Always `system`. |
| `backend` | `string` | 2 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Compute backend actually in use, such as `metal` or `cpu`. |
| `device` | `string` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Human-readable device description. |
| `budget_limit_bytes` | `int64` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Device memory ceiling this process will use. |
| `budget_used_bytes` | `int64` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Device memory currently held by resident models and indexes. |
| `budget_source` | `BudgetSource` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether the ceiling was measured or estimated. An estimate on a discrete card overshoots, and an operator sizing a deployment has to be able to tell which number they are looking at. |
| `version` | `string` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Version of this build. |

## Enums

### `BudgetSource`

How the device memory ceiling was determined.

| Value | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BUDGET_SOURCE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | Default value. Never valid in a response. |
| `BUDGET_SOURCE_MEASURED` | 1 | Read from the device. |
| `BUDGET_SOURCE_ESTIMATED` | 2 | Inferred, because the backend reports no ceiling. |
| `BUDGET_SOURCE_CONFIGURED` | 3 | Set by configuration, overriding whatever the device reports. |
